XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Requests — self-service enrolment workflow for courses, paths, classrooms, programs.

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_request
TABLE.COMMENT: Self-service enrolment requests — course, learning path, classroom, program (polymorphic)

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK user.id — who made the request

FIELD.NAME: item_type
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): course | path | classroom | program

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): ID into the matching table (course/learningpath/classroom/program)

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Legacy column. Equals itemid when item_type=course. Kept for back-compat.

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root id (snapshot of user.open_path at request time)

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the user needs this course

FIELD.NAME: route
FIELD.COMMENT: manager|courseowner|admin — routing decision at submit time

FIELD.NAME: approver_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK user.id — current approver (may change if escalated)

FIELD.NAME: decided_by_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK user.id — who actually made the decision

FIELD.NAME: timedue
FIELD.COMMENT: When SLA deadline hits — used by cron for escalation

INDEX.NAME: idx_userid_courseid
INDEX.COMMENT: Legacy — used by old (item_type=course only) duplicate-request guard
